direction_notes: ACC TUS abolished the significant influence of counterfactual (better vs. worse alternative) choice values on subsequent switching behavior that was present in the control condition, indicating disruption of ACC's role in translating counterfactual value into behavioral change; lOFC TUS (anatomical specificity control) had no such effect.

timing.protocol_description: 30 ms bursts of ultrasound were generated every 100 ms (i.e., a pulse every 100 ms, converting to a 10 Hz pulse repetition rate) for an overall stimulation duration of 40 s, applied immediately prior to each of nine TUS testing sessions interleaved with nine sham sessions per monkey; sham sessions mirrored the TUS procedure except sonication was not triggered.

A control experiment applying the same TUS technique (250 kHz, cigar-shaped focal spot) to lateral orbitofrontal cortex instead of ACC, to test anatomical specificity; other timing/pressure parameters are not restated separately in the text for this control.

source_quotes.n_subjects: TUS was applied to the same ACC region in two of the four macaques.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: The same stimulation was applied to ACC using MRI-guided frameless stereotaxy immediately prior to nine testing sessions that were interleaved, across days, with nine control sessions in which no TUS was applied in each monkey (fig.5a; Methods).
source_quotes.species: Four male rhesus monkeys (Macaca mulatta) were involved in the experiment.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The ultrasound wave frequency was set to the 250 kHz resonance frequency and 30 ms bursts of ultrasound were generated every 100 ms with a digital function generator (Handyscope HS5, TiePie engineering, Sneek, The Netherlands).

source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.pressure_kpa: Voltage values per session ranged from 128 to 136V and corresponded to a peak negative pressure of 1.152 to 1.292MP respectively measured in water with an in house heterodyne interferometer (see 15 for more details about the simulation protocol).
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.pressure_kpa: Based on a mean 66% transmission through the skull 16, the estimated peak negative pressures applied ranged from 0.76 to 0.85 MPa at the target in the brain.

flags.reason: Paper writes 'MP' where MPa is presumably intended (unit abbreviation truncated/typo); value itself recorded as stated.
Timing and pressure parameters for the lOFC control exposure are not restated separately from the ACC protocol in the main text; left not_reported rather than assuming identical values.
Not explicitly restated for lOFC exposure; general TUS methods paragraph (pressure/timing) is written in the context of the ACC experiment.
Classified as inhibitory based on behavioral disruption of counterfactual-value-guided switching; paper does not report a direct neural excitatory/inhibitory measure for the TUS effect itself.
Only 2 of the 4 macaques used in the main fMRI task received TUS; n_subjects reflects those exposed to ultrasound.
